parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and housing for the storage compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet door and internal shelves, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges for opening and closing access to the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the cabinet’s interior.
